summary: Complete testing of Payment Reminder Automation Scheduling feature. Backend: 9/9 tests passed covering GET/PUT /api/operator/reminder-settings endpoints (403 for non-addon operators, defaults, validation of allowed days, persistence), POST /api/admin/cron/process-scheduled-reminders (structure validation), and /api/operator/features (payment_reminder flag). Frontend: All UI components verified - Reminders tab correctly gated by payment_reminder addon, master toggle, before-due chips (7,5,3,2,1), on-due toggle, after-due chips (1,3,5,7,14,30), max reminders dropdown, schedule summary, save button with success toast.

Backend: GET /api/operator/reminder-settings returns defaults (enabled:false, empty arrays) for operator WITH addon but no saved settings
Backend: PUT /api/operator/reminder-settings saves settings correctly (enabled, remind_before_due, remind_on_due, remind_after_due, max_reminders_per_invoice)
Backend: PUT /api/operator/reminder-settings validates remind_before_due days (only allows [1,2,3,5,7])
Backend: PUT /api/operator/reminder-settings validates remind_after_due days (only allows [1,3,5,7,14,30])
Backend: GET /api/operator/reminder-settings returns previously saved settings
Backend: POST /api/admin/cron/process-scheduled-reminders returns expected structure {operators_processed, reminders_sent, skipped, errors}
Backend: GET /api/operator/features returns payment_reminder:true for operator with addon
Frontend: Operator Settings page shows 'Reminders' tab ONLY when operator has payment_reminder addon (3 tabs visible vs 2 tabs for non-addon operator)
Frontend: Reminders tab has master enable/disable toggle (data-testid='reminder-enabled-switch')
Frontend: Before-due day chips present (7,5,3,2,1 days) with blue highlight when active
Frontend: On-due toggle present with amber styling
Frontend: After-due day chips present (1,3,5,7,14,30 days) with red highlight when active

Frontend: Save button works and shows success toast 'Reminder settings saved successfully'
seed_data_creation: Operator 'reminder_test@test.com' with payment_reminder addon already existed (created by main agent). Created new trial operator during testing to verify tab visibility without addon.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment Reminder Automation Scheduling feature fully tested and working. Key implementation: (1) Backend endpoints at /api/operator/reminder-settings with addon check via _has_addon(), validates VALID_BEFORE_DAYS=[1,2,3,5,7] and VALID_AFTER_DAYS=[1,3,5,7,14,30]. (2) Cron processing at POST /api/admin/cron/process-scheduled-reminders calls CronJobService.process_scheduled_reminders() which checks operators with enabled settings, WhatsApp config, and sends reminders based on schedule. (3) Frontend Settings.jsx conditionally renders Reminders tab via hasPaymentReminder from features context. All data-testid attributes present for UI testing.
